449:t_10:20.en:
$$ラルク$$
(But I... I'm really... not that strong...)

449:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$ノリコ$$ is usually so cheerful and full of energy, but she does carry loneliness in her heart.)

449:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$ノリコ$$'s feelings for Big Sis produced 50Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add those to the squad's stock.)

449:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Longing for someone you can never meet again... When you think about it, the multiverse is a cruel place where that can so easily happen...)

449:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is the matter? Is today's star performer troubled by something?」

449:t_10:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「After everyone said all that, even $$ノノ$$ can't help worrying about it.」

449:t_10:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So I'm trying to remember all sorts of things, but...」

449:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Memory is delicate. That is true for machines and humans alike.」

449:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sometimes it returns one day with a little prompting, and sometimes it remains lost forever.」

449:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, shall I try the repair method $$ランド$$ taught me personally?」

449:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly! A lethal blow combining the perfect angle, power, and speed!」

449:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Listen, $$ノノ$$...! How many times have you broken my monitor now!?」

449:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even my famously mild temper has limits, and my patience meter is completely in the red!」

449:t_10:50.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's get fired up for business, business today too!」

449:t_10:53.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then $$ノノ$$ will get ready to deploy too. All right... I'll do my best with Big Sis!」

449:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Lately, I feel this ritual, so sacred to me, has become an empty formality...」

450:t_000:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Brat $$シンジ$$... What were you doing visiting $$ノノ$$?」

450:t_000:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Give me a straight answer. You kept dawdling, so I had to come get you.」

450:t_000:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「If you've got time to act cool, why don't you look after your Princess, nya~?」

450:t_000:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Will you be all right on your own, $$ラルク$$?」

450:t_000:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can move more freely this way.」

450:t_000:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our Princess just can't be honest.」

450:t_000:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ラルク$$... I'm sure $$ノノ$$ will come back.」

450:t_000:12.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She can't. She went to look for a $$バスターマシン$$.」

450:t_000:14.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She's going to get a $$バスターマシン$$ and become $$ノノリリ$$...」

450:t_000:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
(You don't have to become $$ノノリリ$$... I just wish you would stay with me...)

450:t_000:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Aren't any new $$バスターマシン$$s being manufactured?」

450:t_000:17.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$時空震動$$ scrapped all the development plans.」

450:t_000:18.en:
$$チコ$$
「At this rate, my $$キャトフヴァンディス$$ might be the last one.」

450:t_000:19.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's true... We probably won't get any new $$トップレス$$ in this world either.」

450:t_000:20.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That might not be the case.」

450:t_000:21.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you mean, $$ニコラ$$?」

450:t_000:22.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Apparently, children in this world have begun showing abilities similar to those of $$トップレス$$.」

450:t_000:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then maybe I could move $$トライダー$$ with an $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$ too!」

450:t_000:25.en:
$$木下$$
「That would save us on fuel costs, which would be a tremendous help to our company!」

450:t_000:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「You don't have much imagination, Big Bro $$木下$$.」

450:t_000:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Is what you just said true?」

450:t_000:28.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's reliable information from a certain source.」

450:t_000:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Though they apparently consider powers like your $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities to be a kind of $$トップレス$$ ability too, Captain.」

450:t_000:30.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then do $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities disappear with age too?」

450:t_000:33.en:
$$シャア$$
「All children possess $$トップレス$$ powers to some degree, but those powers fade with age...」

450:t_000:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Once they reach the phenomenon called '《$$あがり$$》', they lose their $$トップレス$$ powers and can no longer pilot $$バスターマシン$$s.」

450:t_000:35.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You certainly know a great deal.」

450:t_000:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even I can obtain that much information.」

450:t_000:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「Of course it is. None of the $$トップレス$$ ever told us about it.」

450:t_000:39.en:
$$葵$$
「We heard about it from $$チコ$$, though.」

450:t_000:40.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But let's leave this conversation there. It seems to be a sensitive topic for the $$トップレス$$.」

450:t_000:43.en:
$$タケル$$
(Did Colonel $$シャア$$ deliberately bring it up even though he knew that...?)

450:t_000:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(To keep $$ニコラ$$ in check, since his true intentions remain unclear...? An adult's way of doing things.)
